description: Search Jobsite's published marketing content — blog articles, head-to-head COMPETITOR COMPARISON pages (e.g. 'Jobsite vs Procore', 'Jobsite vs SiteDocs', 'Jobsite vs SafetyCulture'), and pillar guides. Use this whenever the user asks how Jobsite compares to a competitor ('how are you better than Procore', 'Jobsite vs SafetyCulture', 'why pick you over X'), or asks for a published article on a construction-safety topic. Returns matching articles with a relevant excerpt and a link to the full page. This is DISTINCT from lookup_jobsite_docs (product how-to) and search_training_source (OSHA regulatory). If nothing matches, say you don't have an article on it rather than inventing a comparison.

limit.description: Max articles to return. Defaults to 4, cap 6.

query.description: Natural-language query, e.g. 'how is Jobsite better than Procore', 'Jobsite vs SiteDocs', 'confined space article'.

name: search_articles
title: Search Jobsite articles
